title: McDonald's Ba Da Ba Ba Ba
blurb: Five notes, hummed rather than sung, and roughly a billion people can identify them instantly. The I'm Lovin' It sonic logo launched in 2003 with Justin Timberlake attached to the campaign and Pusha T among the writers credited with the hook, which remains one of the great pieces of pop trivia. It is a masterclass in audio branding: short enough to survive any edit, wordless enough to work in every market. The internet now attaches it to anything worth loving — good food, good news, and decisions made confidently at three in the morning.
